newsitem.title: USA: US Diagnostics gets credit facility.
newsitem.headline: US Diagnostics gets credit facility.

text.p: US Diagnostic Inc said Wednesday that it has signed an agreement with DVI Inc to establish a new $50 million credit facility.
The facility, said the company, is being made available principally to finance new acquisitions.
The first $25 million of the facility will be a revolving credit loan secured by certain US Diagnostics accounts receivable.
The second $25 million will be available to finance future acquisitions. This second amount will be advanced upon terms and at interest rates to be agreed upon.

US Diagnostic Inc. owns and operates multi-modality diagnostic imaging centers and related medical facilities in the United States. The company currently owns 118 diagnostic imaging facilities and manages 19 other facilities.
DVI is a commercial finance company dealing in healthcare-related equipment and medical receivables.
